summary: Admin console users intermittently blocked after IdP attribute-transformation change removed tenant claim
description:
Issue summary:
Some DatumWorks engineers (including admins) are getting 401/403 when attempting to open the Redwood private Admin Console after their IdP team rolled out a transformation rule. The transform strips the 'tenant' SAML attribute when a user belongs to a particular federation group. Impact appears intermittent and scoped to users who rely on the attribute to map to a tenant-scoped role-binding.

Impact:
- Multiple DatumWorks admins cannot access admin routes in the console (403 - insufficient scope) or receive 401 on API-to-console handshakes.
- Affects daily operations: inability to view/revoke API keys for impacted users, manage dedicated pools.
- No observed data plane outages; inference traffic continues for non-admin service accounts.

Environment:
- Customer: Private deployment (VPC) using SAML IdP (on-prem ADFS instance) integrated via IdP-proxy.
- Redwood console and auth middleware version: auth-mw v1.12.3, console v3.4.1.
- Region: us-west-2 (private control plane).

Steps to reproduce:
1. Have a user bound to DatumWorks tenant via role-binding that relies on SAML attribute 'tenant_id'.
2. IdP admin applies attribute-transformation rule that conditionally removes 'tenant_id' when user is member of 'external-federation' group.
3. User performs SAML login to Redwood private console URL.
4. Observe redirect loop or final response 401/403 on console.

Observed logs / snippets:
- IdP SAML assertion (redacted): "<Attribute Name=\"tenant_id\">" <-- missing for impacted users.
- Auth-middleware logs (private control plane):
  [2026-03-10T08:17:24Z] INFO incoming_saml_assertion user=alice@datumworks.com assertion_id=...
  [2026-03-10T08:17:24Z] WARN tenant_claim_missing user=alice@datumworks.com mapping_result=deny
  [2026-03-10T08:17:24Z] ERROR authz_decision user=alice@datumworks.com decision=DENY reason=missing_tenant_claim
- Console trace: 403 response payload {"error":"insufficient_scope","detail":"required tenant_id claim not found"}

Additional context:
- The customer reported IdP change at 2026-03-10T07:50Z via support channel.
- A subset of users in same group are unaffected — hypothesis: SAML attribute removal is conditional and depends on group membership and legacy attribute casing.
- Customer is on a Private deployment with strict network controls; we don't have direct IdP access and rely on provided SAML files and metadata.

Recommended immediate workaround:
- Instruct DatumWorks IdP admins to temporarily revert the attribute-transformation or add a mapped fallback attribute with name 'tenant' or 'tenant_id' until permanent fix is applied.
- Create a tenant-scoped fallback role binding for impacted user emails as an emergency remediation (short-lived) so admins can regain access and update IdP mapping from console.

Longer-term remediation plan suggested:
- Add claim-tolerance in auth-middleware to accept alternate claim names and casing (tenant, tenant_id, TenantId) for 30-day compatibility window.
- Add telemetry to auth-middleware to record which claim name was supplied to ease triage for future IdP changes.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis: recent IdP transform introduced attribute name normalization and conditionally stripped 'tenant_id' for federated users. Some clients still send 'tenant' (different casing). Auth middleware strictly expected 'tenant_id' leading to RBAC deny. Evidence: multiple auth-mw WARN and ERROR records showing missing_tenant_claim and presence of alternate attribute names in redacted assertions. Action items: 1) emergency role-binding per customer request; 2) apply middleware claim-tolerance patch; 3) coordinate with DatumWorks IdP to stabilize transformation rules. Logged cross-reference to Slack #support-datumworks and created INT-402 for private control plane schedule.
resolution: Workaround applied: DatumWorks rolled back transformation and SRE applied temporary tenant-scoped role-bindings for impacted admins. Engineering merged auth-mw PR to accept alternate claim names and added claim-telemetry (PR merged 2026-03-12). Canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-13; post-canary we will coordinate production deploy and close this ticket. Follow-ups: update IdP onboarding docs to include attribute name warning, add a console check to surface missing tenant_id during SAML login.
